biggest_catch: For the $400 tier you must open the higher-end Hometown Checking Plus or Premium account AND move $2,000+ in new deposits within 60 days — the basic Hometown/Confidence Checking maxes out at $200. Payout can take up to ~3.5 months after opening (paid by 12/15/2026 for accounts opened Aug–Sep 2026).
catches: $200 tier: open any new personal checking (excludes HSAs) with promo code FCB400 by 11/30/2026 AND complete 10+ qualifying debit card purchases that post and clear within 60 days.
$400 tier: open a Hometown Checking Plus or Premium account AND complete 10+ qualifying debit purchases AND $2,000+ in cumulative new-to-bank deposits within 60 days.
Qualifying deposits are new-to-First Commonwealth Bank funds (transfers from another institution, in-branch, ATM, mobile/remote deposit).
Only for customers residing in First Commonwealth Bank markets (PA, OH, IN, KY, WV); online opening only for residents of PA, OH, and select KY zip codes.

Not eligible if any account owner had an existing First Commonwealth Bank personal checking opened before this account or was paid a First Commonwealth promotional credit using a promo code in the past 12 months.
One checking reward per customer; offer exclusive and not transferable.
Per the bank's account terms, Hometown Checking carries a $2/month service charge (waived with eStatements); Hometown accounts require a $50 opening deposit — confirm current fees on fcbanking.com.
Promotional credit is paid by 12/15/2026 (opened 8/1–9/30/2026) or 2/16/2027 (opened 10/1–11/30/2026); may be reported on IRS Form 1099 as taxable income.
Offer may be extended, modified, or discontinued at any time; must open by 11/30/2026.

steps: Open a new First Commonwealth Bank personal checking account in person at a branch, by phone (844.711.2265), or online at fcbanking.com by 11/30/2026, using promo code FCB400 at account opening.
For $200: complete 10 or more qualifying debit card purchases that post and clear within 60 days of account opening.
For $400: open a Hometown Checking Plus or Premium account and, in addition to the 10 debit purchases, complete $2,000 or more in cumulative new-to-bank deposits within 60 days.
Keep the account active; the promotional credit is deposited by 12/15/2026 (for Aug–Sep 2026 openings) or 2/16/2027 (for Oct–Nov 2026 openings). It may be reported on IRS Form 1099 as taxable income.
